ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict regulatory and expression effects of genomic variants
ranked.summary: Pretrained and multi-task sequence models now resolve per-gene and per-variant effects, increasingly paired with atlases and benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Explicit noise and bias models sharpen RNA-seq cell-type and isoform inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply autoencoders, cross-attention and metacell aggregation to single-cell and spatial RNA-seq measurement problems.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning predicts protein interactions and mutational binding effects
ranked.summary: Recent sequence-based models predict interactions, binding changes and allergenicity directly from sequence, several with explicit interpretability.

ranked.headline: Estimating intrinsic noise and dynamics from noisy time-series and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Noise and interaction structure in cellular systems are increasingly inferred from sparse, noisy measurements rather than assumed a priori.

ranked.headline: Generative models design binders and ligands conditioned on 3D structural states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple diffusion, flow matching, and preference optimization to pretrained structure generators for flexible, physically grounded outputs.

ranked.headline: GPU and SIMD kernels accelerate alignment, read simulation and sequence search tools
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair SIMD and GPU alignment kernels with command-line interfaces for large metagenomic and genome-scale sequence datasets.

ranked.headline: Fusing protein language model embeddings with structure, binding, and chemical data
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein and molecular language models now serve as shared inputs for multimodal encoders across several November 2025 preprints and papers.

ranked.headline: Graph and attention deep learning models predict molecular and protein interactions
ranked.summary: Recent work extends graph-based and multimodal deep models to host-pathogen, activity-cliff and allergenicity prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Gapless and long-read human genome references scale to population multiomic data
ranked.summary: Long-read and T2T assemblies now anchor benchmarking, variant calling, and population-scale multiomic reference resources.

ranked.headline: Generative models for peptides and molecules now steer design with scoring feedback
ranked.summary: Recent work couples generative peptide and molecule models with property predictors and reward-driven optimization in the same loop.

ranked.headline: Condensate aging and maturation governed by viscoelastic and phase-separation mechanisms
ranked.summary: Recent models quantify how condensates age from viscous to elastic states and how misfolded α1-antitrypsin hardens into β-sheet clusters.

ranked.headline: Machine learning links resistance phenotypes and genotypes in bacterial AMR
ranked.summary: Routine disk diffusion readouts and genome-scale evolutionary simulation are now being paired with predictive models of antimicrobial resistance.

ranked.headline: Multimodal and interpretable models predict toxicity from structure and transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Chemical structure and dose-resolved transcriptomics are being fused with interpretable learning to move toxicity prediction beyond black-box endpoints.

ranked.headline: Sequencing and sampling choices determine which bacterial lineages are detected
ranked.summary: Primer design, sampling frames, and genomic metadata shape which microbial lineages enter analyses at all, before any downstream inference.

ranked.headline: Inference directly from raw imaging and nanopore data across biophysical assays
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extract molecular counts, intracellular viscosity, and miRNA identities directly from single-trace or wide-field measurements.

ranked.headline: Models link chromatin packing and accessibility to DNA sequence determinants
ranked.summary: Computational models now resolve linker-DNA, low-affinity motifs and contact persistence as drivers of chromatin structure and accessibility.

ranked.headline: Pear domestication routes, Ks histogram limits and clonally inherited Vitis methylation
ranked.summary: Population-scale pear genomes, polyploid simulation and phased epigenomes now test domestication and whole genome duplication histories directly.

ranked.headline: Kinetic and noise-aware models infer gene expression dynamics from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Temporally resolved single-cell measurements now pair with quantitative models to recover time-dependent gene expression behavior.

ranked.headline: Fusing histology, spatial omics and genomics into joint biomedical representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend joint histology, spatial omics and genomics models to survival analysis, translation and multi-task pathology.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools span parameter estimation, hybrid modelling and single-cell analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release open-source software for standardized model formats, hybrid modelling and interactive single-cell analysis.

ranked.headline: Histopathology input curation and fusion drive cancer prognosis and biomarker prediction
ranked.summary: Curated histology inputs and fusion strategies are being tested against relapse, CNV, and PD-L1 endpoints across prostate and colorectal cancer.

ranked.headline: Simulations map lipid scrambling, pore formation and lipid transfer across membranes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply enhanced sampling and molecular dynamics to resolve lipid transport routes across membranes in three distinct systems.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for mass spectrometry, imaging, and membrane protein pKa analysis
ranked.summary: Four new preprints address reproducibility in omics tooling mainly through design features and benchmarking rather than demonstrated outcomes.

ranked.headline: Reduced and learned representations extract protein dynamics from simulation and imaging
ranked.summary: Intrinsic dimensionality, flexibility, and AFM-based reconstruction tools now complement MD sampling and coarse-grained modeling of protein motions.

ranked.headline: Topological and graph-based encodings of dynamic brain connectivity for learning
ranked.summary: Dynamic brain connectivity is being recast as topological and latent-dynamical representations tailored to downstream learning and comparison tasks.

ranked.headline: Structure-based prediction of ligand and pocket recognition extends to RNA targets
ranked.summary: Structure-based pipelines are now benchmarked on an lncRNA target while ML models gain accuracy from ensemble-derived 3D descriptors.

ranked.headline: Generative and transport models infer single-cell dynamics and regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Preprints pair autoencoders, optimal transport, and cyclic dynamics to recover trajectories and regulatory structure from single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Learned and adaptive tokenizers for protein structure and DNA sequence modeling
ranked.summary: Tokenization of protein structure and genomic DNA is being learned or adapted, alongside KV-cache compression for long-context DNA language model inference.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free and compressed-index methods for microbial metagenomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent work reports alignment-free and compressed-index approaches that are comparable to or exceed established tools in accuracy or runtime.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking structure-based tools for protein and PROTAC complex model evaluation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication assess whether docking, learned, and MD-referenced scoring methods reliably evaluate predicted complex structures.

ranked.headline: Single-cell readouts link perturbations and splicing to gene function and immunotherapy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method apply statistical testing and single-cell profiling at scale to gene function and therapy response.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale mining links plasmids, islands and effectors to bacterial host adaptation
ranked.summary: Large comparative genomic catalogues now make it possible to link mobile elements and secreted effectors to host association and defence functions.

ranked.headline: Mobility-integrated renewal models and open ABC tools for epidemic inference
ranked.summary: Mobility-aware Rt estimation and open ABC-calibrated epidemic models are now published, with validation on England SARS-CoV-2 mortality data.

ranked.headline: Open LLM agents map natural-language questions onto genomic and kinetic model queries
ranked.summary: Open-source LLMs now handle genomic QA, GDC cohort filter generation, and SBML model simulation through natural-language interfaces.

ranked.headline: Computational ranking of gene modules, kinases, and metabolite pathways with validation
ranked.summary: Coherence-based and enrichment-based checks are being used to qualify computational predictions across network, proteomic, and metabolomic data.

ranked.headline: Biophysical and cortical constraints shape learning in neural network models
ranked.summary: Differentiable simulation and cortically constrained RNNs now allow learning dynamics to be fit to neural recordings at scale.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and contrastive models decode plant gene regulation across species
ranked.summary: Preprints now apply deep and contrastive models to plant genomes, with CRISPR validation of maize microprotein regulators of seed amino acid metabolism.

ranked.headline: Flux models link plasmid burden and pathway regulation to E. coli bioproduction
ranked.summary: Computational models now specify plasmid copy number, promoter strength, and pathway dynamics for industrial E. coli process design.

ranked.headline: In silico mechanistic models optimize chemotherapy, ESA and cancer vaccine regimens
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show model-form choice biases optimized dosing and favor identifiability analysis over information criteria for model selection.
